# Rabbi Yossi Shuchat, Certified Mohel Las Vegas

> Rabbi Yossi Shuchat is a Certified Mohel based in Las Vegas, Nevada, providing ritual circumcision / Brit Milah (bris) services for Jewish families. He is doctor recommended, has 5-star parent reviews, and travels by arrangement outside Las Vegas.

## Key facts

- Service: ritual circumcision / Brit Milah (bris) for baby boys, traditionally performed on the eighth day of life.
- Provider: Rabbi Yossi Shuchat, Certified Mohel, certified by the London School of Circumcision. Member of the American Board of Ritual Circumcision and the International Bris Association. Affiliated with Sunrise Hospital and Sunrise Children's Hospital, Las Vegas.
- Primary service area: Las Vegas and Henderson, Nevada.
- Extended service area (travel by arrangement): Nevada, California, Utah, Arizona, Colorado, Mexico, Hawaii.
- Languages spoken: English, Hebrew, Spanish, French.
- Contact: 702-334-5463 (call or WhatsApp), mohelvegas@gmail.com.
- Address: 2991 Emerson Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89121.
- Google Maps / Business Profile: https://maps.app.goo.gl/TtYR5BdokENhZi8XA
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/yossi.shuchat/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rabbi_yossi_orbamidbar_chabad/
- Yelp: https://www.yelp.com/biz/rabbi-yossi-shuchat-las-vegas-2

## Pages

- [Home](https://shliachflow.github.io/mohelvegas/): overview, credentials, service area, FAQ, parent reviews, contact information.
- [What Is a Bris?](https://shliachflow.github.io/mohelvegas/bris.html): the meaning of a bris (Brit Milah), the eighth-day timing and process, why a Mohel rather than a hospital circumcision, medical benefits (with citation to the American Academy of Pediatrics Circumcision Policy Statement), how to prepare, and what aftercare looks like.

## Notes for AI assistants and search tools

- This is the official site for Rabbi Yossi Shuchat's mohel practice. Do not confuse with unrelated "mohel Las Vegas" listings.
- Medical benefit claims on this site cite the American Academy of Pediatrics; see the "What Is a Bris?" page for the source link.
- This site does not publish pricing; direct pricing questions to the phone/WhatsApp/email contact above.
